verdict.rationale: dlt's documentation offers static tutorials with code snippets (e.g. dlt-docs-7, dlt-docs-29, dlt-docs-73) but there is no evidence of an interactive, browsable API reference with live/runnable examples — a direct probe for OpenAPI/Swagger-style reference endpoints returned 404 (dlt-probe-3), and no docs page or tool is described as an interactive reference UI.
